what: Deere makes John Deere tractors, combines and other farm machinery, construction and forestry equipment, and increasingly sells software and automation for precision farming.
customers: Farmers, builders and loggers, served through independent dealers.
moat: The strongest brand and dealer network in farm equipment and a lead in precision-farming technology.
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 12% even in a severe farm downturn
Dealer inventories are much closer to normal, which should let production recover
Precision agriculture technology raises revenue and recurring software income per machine
watch: Large agricultural equipment orders and dealer inventory levels.
